paragraphs: ResumeForge is a production-grade MERN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js) web application designed for creating, storing, and customizing professional resumes. It features a live dual-pane editor, multiple ATS-safe templates, pixel-perfect PDF export, secure JWT user authentication, and an AI-powered Job Match Analyzer backed by Google Gemini.
features: JWT-Based Authentication: Secure stateless token issuance on registration and login.
Bcrypt Password Hashing: Passwords salted (10 rounds) and never stored in plain text.
Route Protection: Middleware ensures users can only access and modify their own resumes.
Sensitive Data Exclusion: Passwords automatically stripped from JSON responses.
Tabbed Editor: Sections for Personal Info, Education, Experience, Projects, Skills, and Certifications.
